prompt: Generate a vertical 9:16 snapshot taken on a cheap disposable film camera with harsh on-camera flash, inside a British corner shop at night. Close on the bread shelf: one last loaf of plain white bread, its shelf-edge label stacked with stickers, a peeled "£1" sticker half covered by a fresh bright one reading "£5" in bold black print. A shopper's hand, cropped at the wrist, hovers over the loaf. Flash falloff is brutal: the shelves two metres back are already near black, and at the edge of the light the dark has a shape in it, taller than the shelving, impossible to read. Red-eye colour cast, slight motion blur, dust specks on the print, date stamp in orange in the corner. Thanks.
